en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a city square with modernist mid-20th-century buildings. The most prominent feature is a tall office building with the text 'TRAFIKBOLAGEN för Järnväg' at the top, and several other business signs at street level, including 'NORRLAND BYGGPLAST' and 'PHILIPS RADIO V'. There are several trees in the foreground and classic street lamps. The architectural style and signage suggest a northern European, likely Scandinavian, city.
